tokens.npc_dota_hero_jakiro_bio: Even among magical beasts, a twin-headed dragon is a freak. Equal parts ice and fire, cunning and rage, the creature known as Jakiro glides over charred and ice-bound battlefields, laying waste to any who would bear arms against it. Pyrexae dragon clutches always contain two fledglings. Famous for their viciousness even from the first moments of life, newly hatched dragons of this species will try to kill their sibling while still in the nest. Only the strongest survive. In this way is the strength of the Pyrexae line ensured. By some accident of nature, the freak Jakiro hatched from a single egg, combining in a single individual the full range of abilities found within the diverse Pyrexae species. Trapped within the armature of its monstrous body, the powers of ice and fire combine, and now no enemy is safe.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_jakiro_hype: Jakiro is their own best friend. Not content to merely punish enemies with fire, the twins freeze them in place to force them to stand there and burn. With foes aflame, they turn to inflicting massive damage on enemy structures with their liquid fire.

* Dual Breath has the following targeting functionalities: 
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** Release its breath toward the unit-targeted position.
** {{Symbol|Target|Point}} or {{Symbol|Target|Ground}}
*** Releases its breath toward the point-targeted direction.

* [[File:Dota2 Jakiro Dual Breath Visualization icon-1.png|105px|]][[File:Dota2 Jakiro Dual Breath Visualization icon-2.png|105px|]]
** Can affect enemy units at max {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Dual Breath value2}}+{{#var:Dual Breath value3}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{#var:Dual Breath value2 tal}}+{{#var:Dual Breath value3}}}}|25tal}})-distance away with the travel distance and end radius.
** The total ability area-of-effect is shaped like a cone.

* {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}

*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]] [[File:Dota2 Jakiro Ice Breath icon.png|21px|Ice Breath]]
***# The Ice Breath 0-damage instance.

***#* The {{M|movement speed}} slow.
***#* The {{M|attack speed}} slow.
***#* Reapplying the slow debuff updates the ability values correspondingly and refreshes the duration.
*** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]] [[File:Dota2 Jakiro Fire Breath icon.png|21px|Fire Breath]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|dual_breath_burn}} 
**** Applies the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} component {{#var:Dual Breath type2 value1}} seconds after cast.
**** {{Symbol|Dot|On}} {{Symbol|Dot|Off}} ... {{Symbol|Dot|Off}}
***** {{#expr:{{#var:Dual Breath type2 value1}}+{{#var:Dual Breath basic3}}}} seconds upon cast, the Fire Breath applies the first 0-damage instance.
**** {{Symbol|Dot|Off}} {{Symbol|Dot|On}} ... {{Symbol|Dot|Off}}
***** Subsequent instances deal {{calc|v1*{{#var:Dual Breath basic1}}|v1={{#var:Dual Breath type2 value3}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*{{#var:Dual Breath basic1}}|v1={{#var:Dual Breath type2 value3 tal}}}}|25tal}}) {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} to affected enemy units in {{#var:Dual Breath basic1}}-second intervals, over {{#expr:{{#var:Dual Breath type2 value4}}/{{#var:Dual Breath basic1}}}} instance, within the area-of-effect.
***** Reapplying the damage per second debuff refreshes the duration, but does not update the damage instance correspondingly of its level.
***** The damage instance continues with the same intervals as the first debuff application.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|fx|v}}
** All ability effects are applied immediately within the area-of-effect after the effect delay despite the visual effects.

* [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] [[File:Dota2 Pto.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 toP.png|21px]] {{hi|Jakiro}} [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} [[File:Dota2 Pto.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 LtoL.png|21px]][[File:Dota2 toP.png|21px]] [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]]
** Has a {{#var:Ice Path basic1}}-distance offset in front of Jakiro's {{M|facing angle}}.
*** Hence, it affects enemy units to up to {{Symbol|bonus cas}} {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Ice Path basic1}}+{{#var:Ice Path value1}}+{{#var:Ice Path value2}}}} ({{Code|OQ}}) range away with the path distance and path radius.
*** Also affects {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Ice Path value2}}-{{#var:Ice Path basic1}}}}-distance ({{Code|PO}}) behind Jakiro.
** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
*** Grants multiple {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Ice Path value2}}-radius [[flying vision]] cells along the path for the entire duration.

* {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|ice_path_stun}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Can only affect the same enemy units once per cast.
** Both the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|ice_path}} duration and {{M|stun}} duration are independent of each other.
*** However, the stun duration {{M|dispels}} itself once the path expires.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
{{Jakirocard}}

* {{Symbol|Attack Modifier}}
** Liquid Fire is an active attack modifier, and has the following properties:
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|[[Cast Range|CastRange]] {{=}} Hero[[Attack Range|AtkRange]]}}
*** Specifically affected by {{M|attack range}} sources of the same range-type as the caster.
** Has a different cast range when casting Liquid Fire manually; {{M|Autocast}} uses Jakiro's current {{M|attack range|x}}.
*** Has Autocast off by default.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Impact}}
*** Applies all ability effects as long as the attack modifier {{M|projectile}} impacts, regardless if the attack {{M|missed}} or is {{M|disjointed}}.
** {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
*** This ability component can be applied by other [[instant attack]] sources.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
** Does not apply at all if the enemy unit is affected by the following sources prior projectile impact:
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
*** {{M|Invisible}} sources.
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|jakiro_liquid_fire_burn}}
*#* Deals {{Code|({{calc|v1*{{#var:Liquid Fire basic1}}|v1={{#var:Liquid Fire value3}}}} + Max[[Health|HP]] × {{ValueColor||{{#expr:{{Show|T|Jakiro|v4l}}/100*{{#var:Liquid Fire basic1}}}}}|tal|x}}) × f([[Buildings]])}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} to affected enemy units in {{#var:Liquid Fire basic1}}-second intervals, starting {{#var:Liquid Fire basic1}} seconds after debuff application, over {{#expr:{{#var:Liquid Fire value4}}/{{#var:Liquid Fire basic1}}}} damage instances per full debuff duration.
*#* Reapplying the debuff refreshes its duration.
*#* {{cf|talnotes}} Both the base damage per second and {{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||max health as damage|25tal}} are applied as one damage instance in the {{M|combat log}}.
*# Jakiro's attack instance.

* Cannot be cast on the following units:
** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_jakiro
data.bio_loc: Even among magical beasts, a twin-headed dragon is a freak. Equal parts ice and fire, cunning and rage, the creature known as Jakiro glides over charred and ice-bound battlefields, laying waste to any who would bear arms against it. Pyrexae dragon clutches always contain two fledglings. Famous for their viciousness even from the first moments of life, newly hatched dragons of this species will try to kill their sibling while still in the nest. Only the strongest survive. In this way is the strength of the Pyrexae line ensured. By some accident of nature, the freak Jakiro hatched from a single egg, combining in a single individual the full range of abilities found within the diverse Pyrexae species. Trapped within the armature of its monstrous body, the powers of ice and fire combine, and now no enemy is safe.
data.hype_loc: Jakiro is their own best friend. Not content to merely punish enemies with fire, the twins freeze them in place to force them to stand there and burn. With foes aflame, they turn to inflicting massive damage on enemy structures with their liquid fire.
data.npe_desc_loc: Freezes and burns enemies with magic

abilities.name: jakiro_dual_breath
abilities.desc_loc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
abilities.lore_loc: Pyrexae dragons have tremendously dangerous breath for each branch of the species; combining them is unimaginable.
notes_loc: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: jakiro_ice_path
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
abilities.lore_loc: Jakiro's cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.
notes_loc: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
facets_loc: Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.

abilities.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
abilities.desc_loc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
abilities.lore_loc: The left maw of Jakiro opens, laying waste to any in its path.
notes_loc: Works on both units and buildings.
abilities.shard_loc: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

abilities.name: jakiro_liquid_ice
abilities.desc_loc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
abilities.lore_loc: The right maw of Jakiro opens, punishing all with bitter frost.
abilities.shard_loc: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

abilities.name: jakiro_double_trouble
abilities.desc_loc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes_loc: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
facets_loc: Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.

abilities.name: jakiro_macropyre
abilities.desc_loc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
abilities.lore_loc: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.
notes_loc: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_jakiro
talents.desc_loc: Increases both stun and path duration.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_jakiro_3
talents.name_loc: +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% Liquid Frost and Fire Max Health Damage
talents.desc_loc: Deals +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% of the target's max health as damage. This damage does not apply to Buildings.
